title: Understanding LASSO Regularization
text: LASSO regularization adds a penalty equal to the absolute value of the magnitude of coefficients to the loss function. This can lead to some coefficients being exactly zero, effectively selecting a simpler model.

title: Effect of LASSO on Model Variance
text: LASSO tends to reduce model complexity by shrinking some coefficients to zero. How does reducing model complexity affect variance?

title: Impact of Reduced Complexity
text: When model complexity is reduced, what typically happens to the model variance?
